title: Pushforward Probability
statement: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be finite sets, let $p$ be a probability distribution on $\alpha$, and let $f\colon\alpha\to\beta$. For every $b\in\beta$, the probability assigned to $b$ by the distribution induced by $f$ is $\sum_{a\in\alpha:\,f(a)=b}p(a)$.
